info.name: Chat Microservices (Gateway) - Full Collection
info.description: Full collection for Chat microservices (all requests go through API Gateway at http://localhost:3005). Includes REST endpoints, example cURL commands, Kafka & Redis test endpoints, and Socket.IO test instructions.

item.name: Register
item.description:
Register a new user.

cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST {{base_url}}/auth/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Akshay","email":"akshay@example.com","password":"password123"}'
```

item.name: Login
item.description:
Login and receive JWT token. Save token into {{token}} environment variable.

cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST {{base_url}}/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"akshay@example.com","password":"password123"}'
```

item.name: Get me (profile)
item.description:
Get current user profile. cURL:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" {{base_url}}/auth/me
```

item.name: Get user by id
item.description:
Get user details by id.

cURL:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" {{base_url}}/users/1
```

item.name: Update user
item.description:
Update user profile. cURL:
```bash
curl -X PUT {{base_url}}/users/1 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Akshay Updated"}'
```

item.name: Search users
item.description:
Search users by query. cURL:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' '{{base_url}}/users/search?q=akshay'
```

item.name: Create Room
item.description:
Create one-to-one room. cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST {{base_url}}/chat/room -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"user1":1,"user2":2}'
```

item.name: Create Group
item.description:
Create group chat. cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST {{base_url}}/chat/group -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Friends","members":[1,2,3]}'
```

item.name: Send Message (REST)
item.description:
Sends message (this will persist and publish to Kafka). cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST {{base_url}}/chat/send -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"roomId":1,"senderId":1,"content":"Hello"}'
```

item.name: Fetch messages
item.description:
Get messages for roomId=1. cURL:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' {{base_url}}/chat/messages/1
```

item.name: Store Message (internal)
item.description:
Store message directly in message-service (gateway forwards). cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST {{base_url}}/messages/store -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"room_id":1,"sender_id":1,"message":"Hello saved"}'
```

item.name: Message history
item.description:
Get message history for room. cURL:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' {{base_url}}/messages/history/1
```

item.name: Create Notification
item.description:
Create a notification (gateway -> notification-service). cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST {{base_url}}/notifications -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"user_id":1,"message":"You have a new message"}'
```

item.name: Get Notifications
item.description:
Get notifications for userId=1. cURL:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' {{base_url}}/notifications/1
```

item.name: Rate limit test
item.description: Endpoint to test gateway rate-limiting (if implemented).

item.name: Kafka - Produce test event (via Gateway)
item.description:
Produces a Kafka event through the gateway to test consumers. cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST {{base_url}}/internal/kafka/produce -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"topic":"message_created","payload":{"roomId":1,"senderId":1,"content":"kafka test"}}'
```

item.name: Redis - Publish test
item.description:
Publishes a Redis message on channel via gateway. cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST {{base_url}}/internal/redis/publish -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"channel":"chat_messages","message":{"roomId":1,"senderId":1,"content":"redis test"}}'
```

item.name: Socket.IO - Connect (instructions)
item.description:
Postman now supports WebSocket connections via the 'WebSocket Request' type, but for socket.io tests you can use a small JS snippet or the Node `socket.io-client`.

1) Recommended: use `socket.io-client` in Node:

   node -e "const io=require('socket.io-client'); const s=io('http://localhost:3005',{auth:{token:'<JWT>'}}); s.on('connect',()=>{console.log('connected',s.id); s.emit('join_room',1); s.emit('send_message',{roomId:1,content:'hello from client'});}); s.on('message',m=>console.log('msg',m));"

2) Postman WebSocket may not perform Socket.IO handshakes; use the node snippet above.
